_comment: Pinned third-party TypeScript packages for the Tier A coverage study
(#493, TypeScript port #536). Hermeticity here means SOURCE hermeticity —
the harness only parses, encodes, compiles and re-encodes these files, it
never installs or runs them — so the bar is: hand-written TypeScript (no
generated or transpiled sources, no .d.ts-only packages, which declare
types and no runtime declarations at all), permissively licensed (every
pin below is MIT; unjs/consola and unjs/pathe carry a plain MIT LICENSE
file that GitHub's classifier reports as NOASSERTION), zero runtime
dependencies in the studied subtree, and small enough to shallow-clone.
Each `ref` is a commit SHA resolved from the repo's default branch on
2026-09-05 via the GitHub API, so a Tier A number is reproducible; bump it
deliberately, never to chase a number. `lib` is the subtree that is
actually studied; the harness additionally skips *.spec.ts, *.test.ts,
*.bench.ts and *.d.ts inside it. An unreachable pin is reported separately
and is NOT scored as a failure.
